rubric: 1=AIXM5.2 open · 2=AIXM5.1/4.5 or open ARINC424 · 3=open structured/clean eAIP · 4=open eAIP irregular · 5=eAIP free-account (EAD) · 6=open vector PDF · 7=PDF portal/account · 8=scanned PDF(OCR) or account+agreement · 9=restricted/paid · 10=paper/none (+1 for portal/scale friction)

US.notes: Open free CIFP coded procedures in ARINC 424-18 (28-day cycle, no account); NASR also in AIXM 5.1 and d-TPP vector-PDF charts.

CA.notes: AIP Canada / Canada Air Pilot (CAP) procedures are digital vector PDF only with no open coded/AIXM database; coded data sold via NAV CANADA store.

CN.notes: Portal is login-walled (username granted only on email application); no public coded/ARINC424 DB, procedures are PDF charts needing per-chart navigation and Chinese-text handling.

AU.notes: Open access; DAP East/West instrument procedures are vector PDF charts, AIP Book HTML/PDF, eAIP+AIXM migration in progress but not yet the published source.

RU.aip_authority: Centre of Aeronautical Information (CAI), FSUE State ATM Corporation
RU.notes: Open bilingual RU/EN vector PDFs per aerodrome behind an HTML frameset; parser must handle per-AD PDF navigation, Cyrillic text and chart-graphic layouts.

BR.notes: Open Eurocontrol-style eAIP HTML plus openly published AIXM 5.1 datasets and PDF charts each AIRAC; AIXM path directly machine-readable — easiest non-US source here.

FR.notes: Open eAIP HTML viewer plus open AIXM 4.5 / XML_SIA airspace data on data.gouv.fr each AIRAC, but SID/STAR/IAC procedures are PDF charts.

IN.aip_authority: Airports Authority of India (AAI) — AIM India
IN.notes: Open eAIP, no login; GEN/ENR/AD in HTML but instrument procedures are linked PDF charts, plus per-AMDT folder navigation.

JP.aip_authority: JCAB / Japan AIS Center (AIS Japan, SWIM portal)
JP.notes: Free registration required; provides eAIP HTML+PDF plus AIXM 4.5/5 XML exports, so an AIXM path exists but procedure charts are PDF and access sits behind login.

GB.notes: Openly accessible AURORA eAIP (legacy frameset HTML); GEN/ENR text is HTML but procedures are embedded PDF charts and per-AIRAC dated URLs need cycle-aware navigation (AIXM 5.1 via EAD).

ID.notes: AIS Center portal behind free sign-up/login; eAIP delivered as HTML index plus PDF procedure charts with clunky portal navigation.

DE.notes: Free Basic IFR portal (no login) wraps HTML navigation around per-page PDF documents; AIXM 5.1.1 only via EAD, so the open path forces per-chart PDF parsing.

IT.notes: eAIP-Italia requires free ENAV registration; procedures delivered as PDF charts (AIXM 5.1.1 only via separate AIFS/EAD feed), so a parser needs authenticated sessions plus PDF extraction.

AR.notes: Open PDF-based AIP (GEN/ENR/AD) in Spanish/English with SID/STAR/IAC as vector PDF charts; no AIXM (site intermittently returns 503).

MX.notes: Thales AIM eAIP (AIXM 5.1 internal, 28-day AIRAC) behind free registration; procedures as eAIP HTML plus PDF SID/STAR/IAC charts rather than open AIXM downloads.

IR.aip_authority: Civil Aviation Organization of Iran (CAO.IRI) AIS
IR.notes: English AIP PDFs openly downloadable from a clunky Liferay portal, but per-document navigation, intermittent 503s and chart-graphic procedures make extraction awkward; no AIXM.

TR.aip_authority: DHMI (Devlet Hava Meydanlari Isletmesi) / Turkish ANSP
TR.notes: DHMI publishes SID/STAR/IAP charts as scanned-image PDFs (confirmed via binary analysis of LT_AD_2_LTFM_SID and LT_AD_2_LTAC_STAR files: FlateDecode image streams, no embedded text fonts). Portal ssd.dhmi.gov.tr shows AIP SUBSCRIPTION FORM, implying formal subscription step; charts are publicly linked from dhmi.gov.tr/AIPDocuments/ but portal login is indicated. DHMI also publishes AIXM 5.1 and CSV terrain/obstacle datasets per EUROCONTROL confluence page, but instrument procedure data (SID/STAR/IAP charts) remain scanned PDF only. AIRAC cycle cadence followed. +0 portal friction already captured in score-8 for scanned PDF plus account.

ZA.aip_authority: SACAA / ATNS (Air Traffic and Navigation Services)
ZA.notes: ATNS SmartAIM eAIP HTML at cad.atns.co.za appears publicly accessible (no login seen); also PDF sections via caasanwebsitestorage.blob.core.windows.net. However, server is intermittently 503 and ~300 instrument procedures were suspended as of Oct 2025 (ATNS operational crisis). Quarterly AIRAC cycle. No AIXM coded output. Confidence medium due to server reliability issues and ongoing procedure suspensions.

CO.notes: Aerocivil publishes eAIP Colombia via atnaerocivil.gov.co in open HTML (no login). Current amendment AMDT 71/26 (Apr 2026) confirmed; regular 28-day AIRAC cadence. eAIP HTML pages cover general/enroute sections as readable text; however, actual SID/STAR/IAP procedures for airports (AD 2 sections) are served as separate PDF chart files embedded in the eAIP (e.g. SID - ICAO - RWY 14R 14L EVRA5B ZIP5H.pdf for SKBO). Tabular procedure descriptions also published as PDF supplements. No AIXM or coded DB. Score 6: open but procedures are PDF charts within eAIP structure, plus portal was intermittently unavailable (503) during research. Confidence medium due to server instability.

PH.aip_authority: CAAP (Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines)
PH.notes: Paid annual subscription required via ais.caap.gov.ph ($179-325 USD international / PHP 1,792-5,600 local). eAIP delivered as PDF. April 2026 Indra contract will eventually introduce AIXM-compliant system but not yet live. No free public access to instrument procedures. Subscription covers SID/STAR/IAP charts in PDF format.

ES.aip_authority: ENAIRE (Entidad Pública Empresarial Aeropuertos Españoles y Navegación Aérea)
ES.notes: ENAIRE publishes open eAIP HTML at aip.enaire.es with SID/STAR/IAP in HTML+PDF per AIRAC cycle (28-day). AIXM 5.1 datasets openly downloadable from DatosDigitales page but cover airspace, obstacles, aerodromes, and en-route data — not coded instrument procedures. Procedures require parsing eAIP HTML + chart PDFs. No registration required. Also accessible via EUROCONTROL EAD (free account).

VE.notes: INAC publishes eAIP HTML at inac.gob.ve/eaip/ but the site is intermittently down (503/unavailable at research time; last confirmed snapshot 2023-12-28). Venezuela faces severe political/economic disruption; INAC revoked foreign airline permits late 2025; GNSS interference reported 2025. eAIP structure appears EUROCONTROL-compliant HTML when online, but reliability is very poor and server is frequently offline. Most recent publicly confirmed cycle: 2023-12-28. Score 8: eAIP HTML in principle but unreliable/offline access, uncertain currency; effectively restricted by outages. Confidence low due to inability to confirm current availability.

SE.aip_authority: LFV (Luftfartsverket — Swedish Aviation Authority / ANS provider)
SE.notes: LFV publishes eAIP HTML at aro.lfv.se via the AROWeb platform. Current cycle (AIRAC AIP AMDT 4-2026, effective 11 Jun 2026) viewable from index-v2.html. Full AROWeb flight-planning features require account registration; eAIP document browsing and IAIP.zip bulk download are available without login. SID/STAR/IAP in HTML and PDF. Also in EUROCONTROL EAD (free account) as AIXM 4.5/5.1. No open coded procedure database.

NO.aip_authority: Avinor AS (AIS authority under Civil Aviation Authority Norway / Luftfartstilsynet)
NO.notes: Avinor publishes standard EUROCONTROL-format eAIP HTML at aim-prod.avinor.no, updated every 28-day AIRAC cycle. SID/STAR/IAP procedure data in HTML tables and PDF chart files. No registration required to browse/read. AIP also available via EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free account) in AIXM 4.5/5.1. eAIP HTML URLs embed AIRAC cycle number and effective date. No open coded ARINC 424 database.

TH.notes: Thailand CAAT publishes a full eAIP at aip.caat.or.th, openly accessible without registration; AIRAC-cycle dates visible through 2025/2026 (AMDT 01/26 confirmed). eAIP HTML AD-2 pages link SID/STAR procedures exclusively as external PDF chart files (confirmed for RKSS/VTBS pages: no HTML leg tables, only PDF links). Charts are in a /graphics/ folder as separate PDFs. Server returned 503 on some fetches suggesting intermittent availability. SID/STAR PDF charts confirmed accessible (graphics/280000.pdf linked). No AIXM coded data. Score 6 reflects open vector-PDF-via-portal model; actual PDF chart format (vector vs scanned) could not be directly confirmed due to 503 errors, but CAAT eAIP toolbox documentation suggests machine-generated PDFs likely containing selectable text. Score conservatively set at 6 (open vector PDF via portal).

DZ.notes: Open access PDF AIP at sia-enna.dz, no login required. SID/STAR charts published as individual PDF files per aerodrome (e.g. /PDF/AIP/AD/AD2/DAUH/SID.pdf). Only select aerodromes have SID/STAR charts; others have approach-only. No AIXM or HTML procedure tables. PDFs appear to be vector-text (not scanned) based on file characteristics. AIRAC update cadence confirmed from amendment dates.

NZ.aip_authority: Airways NZ / Aeropath Ltd (on behalf of NZ CAA)
NZ.notes: Freely accessible at aip.net.nz (terms-of-use disclaimer only, no registration). Vols 2 & 3 contain IFR instrument procedures (SID/STAR/IAP) as vector PDF charts. Updated 6x per year. No AIXM or coded ARINC 424 database publicly available. Physical subscriptions sold via shop.aeropath.aero.

PK.notes: Pakistan eAIP is published by PAA (post-2022 PCAA/PAA bifurcation) at paawebadmin.paa.gov.pk. eAIP index and HTML sections appear publicly accessible without login (confirmed GEN/index pages reachable). Instrument procedure charts (SID/STAR/IAP) for OPIS, OPKC, OPLA etc. are linked as external PDF files from the HTML AD-2 pages, not embedded as HTML tables. PDF chart format not directly confirmed as scanned vs vector due to server 503 responses during testing, but structure mirrors typical ICAO eAIP-HTML with PDF chart attachments. paawebadmin server returns 503 intermittently suggesting stability issues (minor +0 portal friction). No AIXM coded data. AIRAC 28-day cadence followed with AMDT 01/25 confirmed March 2025. Confidence medium: PDF chart quality unverified.

SA.aip_authority: General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) / Saudi Air Navigation Services (SANS)
SA.notes: Saudi Arabia AIP is published by SANS (Saudi Air Navigation Services) at aimss.sans.com.sa. eAIP HTML pages (airport AD-2 sections) are openly accessible without login and link to procedure charts as separate PDF files. SID/STAR charts are vector-text PDFs (confirmed: OERK STAR RWY 33L-33R aeronautical data tabulation and OEDF SID tabulation PDFs contain embedded TrueType fonts, selectable text, created via Bullzip PDF Printer from MS Word). Additional services (NOTAM/PIB, registration on WBPBS) require free registration per GEN 3.1 documentation. eAIP is current with AIRAC AMDT 06/25 dated June 2025 confirmed. Score 7 reflects eAIP-HTML portal with PDF chart downloads requiring navigation per airport/cycle, and optional free-account for briefing services; vector PDFs lower friction vs scanned. No AIXM coded data.

CL.notes: DGAC IFIS portal at aipchile.dgac.gob.cl serves AIP Vol II (MAP) procedures openly without login. SID/STAR/IAC documents are individual PDF files per airport/procedure (e.g. SCFA STAR 1.pdf). Confirmed vector PDF with selectable text (Excel-to-PDF coordinate tables also published). No AIXM or coded database. AIRAC-aligned amendments, most recent AMDT 66 effective May 2026. Score 6: open vector PDF charts requiring per-airport per-procedure navigation.

FI.notes: Open HTML eAIP at ais.fi/eaip (no registration). Each AIRAC cycle published at a dated subdirectory URL. Aerodrome sections reference SID/STAR/IAP chart pages as PDF links within the HTML eAIP framework. ECAC state — AIXM 5.1 via EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free registration). Updated each AIRAC cycle.

PE.aip_authority: CORPAC S.A. (Corporación Peruana de Aeropuertos y Aviación Comercial)
PE.notes: CORPAC publishes a full EUROCONTROL-style eAIP at eaip-peru.corpac.gob.pe in open HTML format (no login required). Airport sections SP-AD 2 SPJC confirmed. Active AIRAC updates through 2025 (AMDT 33/25 effective Jul 2025). ENR 1.5 covers holding/approach/departure procedures. eAIP server intermittently returns 307 redirects and 503 errors during research, reducing confidence slightly. No AIXM or coded DB. Score 4: open eAIP HTML, parseable but server instability and irregular structure add friction.

PT.notes: Open HTML eAIP at ais.nav.pt (no registration). Covers Portugal mainland, Madeira, and Azores. Aerodrome sections (LP-AD-2.*) are HTML pages; SID/STAR/IAP procedure charts linked as PDF files within the eAIP. ISO download also available free of charge. ECAC state — AIXM 5.1 via EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free registration). Updated each AIRAC cycle.

MY.notes: Freely accessible eAIP HTML at aip.caam.gov.my; AIRAC-cycle updates confirmed through 2025-2026. Covers Peninsular Malaysia (WM prefix) and Sabah/Sarawak (WB prefix) under a single AIP. Structured HTML tables parseable; also PDF format available. No AIXM coded data. Electronic-only since 2022.

GR.notes: HASP publishes eAIP at aisgr.hasp.gov.gr, open access, no login required. SID/STAR procedures delivered as PDF chart files (e.g. LG_AD_2_LGZA_SID-2_en.pdf) rather than structured HTML procedure tables. Older HCAA portal (ypa.gr/hellasais) required free registration but is superseded by HASP. Also on EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free reg). AIRAC cycle aligned.

PL.aip_authority: PANSA (Polish Air Navigation Services Agency) / AIS Poland
PL.notes: eAIP IFR published in HTML format at ais.pansa.pl/eAIPIFR with publicly accessible cycle URLs (no login on direct URLs). The formal AIP Poland subscription product is delivered via MS SharePoint and is paid/subscriber-only. SID/STAR/IAP charts are PDF files referenced from the HTML. ECAC state — AIXM 5.1 via EAD Basic (free registration). Split access model adds friction; scored 5.

PF.aip_authority: SIA / DGAC (Direction des Services de la Navigation Aérienne, France)
PF.notes: French Polynesia is covered under SIA France PAC-P eAIP region. eAIP HTML pages (e.g. FR-AD-2.NTAA-fr-FR.html) are openly accessible under sia.aviation-civile.gouv.fr/media/dvd/eAIP_*/PAC-P/. HTML contains aerodrome operational text; SID/STAR/IAP procedure charts are linked as PDF files. Open access, no account required. AIRAC 28-day cycle. French language. SIA open data also on data.gouv.fr but procedure-level data is chart-PDF only.

MG.aip_authority: ASECNA (Agency for the Safety of Air Navigation in Africa and Madagascar)
MG.notes: Madagascar is a founding ASECNA member; AIP served via aim.asecna.aero (eAIP in French-language HTML + PDF charts). Cover page (Jun 2026 AIRAC cycle) accessible without login. Individual procedure charts for FMMI (Antananarivo/Ivato) confirmed accessible as vector PDFs (e.g. 09AD2-FMMI-SID-RNAV11.pdf, STAR-RNAV29.pdf, IAC-ILS). HTML eAIP tables also accessible. Subscription form present for offline/SharePoint download but public online access is open. Procedures-in-chart-PDF format with French-language navigation; no AIXM coded data. Score 7: open vector PDF charts via portal navigation, French interface, no coded database.

KR.aip_authority: Korea Office of Civil Aviation (KOCA) / AIM
KR.notes: South Korea KOCA publishes eAIP at aim.koca.go.kr; HTML AD-2 pages are openly accessible without registration. SID/STAR procedures are referenced exclusively as external PDF chart links (not HTML tables, confirmed for RKSS and RKSI pages). Charts are scanned image PDFs confirmed by binary analysis of RKSI STAR PDF (2025-06-26 issue): content is DCTDecode JPEG streams with no embedded text fonts, requiring OCR. eAIP HTML pages include general aerodrome data (navaids, runways, frequencies) in HTML but all procedure charts (SID/STAR/IAP) are image-scan PDFs. Bilingual Korean/English. AIRAC 28-day cycle with AMDT 13/25 confirmed Dec 2025. No AIXM coded data. Score 8 (scanned PDF, open portal, no account needed).

MM.aip_authority: Department of Civil Aviation (DCA) Myanmar / AIS Myanmar
MM.notes: DCA Myanmar publishes eAIP in HTML and PDF via ais.gov.mm; 4th edition described as available in both AIXM 5.1 XML and PDF. However the eAIP history page (ais.gov.mm/eAIP/history-en-GB.html) shows the last effective issue is 30 MAY 2022 with no 2023/2024/2025 updates detected — likely a result of the ongoing post-coup civil conflict (2021 coup caused ~80% AIS staff strike). AIP is nominally open-access; NOTAM portal requires registration. PBN SID/STAR supplements for Yangon, Mandalay, Heho etc. exist in HTML format within the 2022 edition. Score reflects eAIP-HTML that is open but severely stale and structurally irregular (frameset), with uncertainty about whether AIXM 5.1 download is actually accessible; confidence medium due to stale data and civil disruption.

CD.notes: RVA operates an AIP portal at aiprdc.rva.cd requiring account creation (Créer un compte); format appears PDF-based. AAC/RDC is the regulator, RVA the ANSP managing 53 airports. No AIXM or coded data found. French-language content. Confidence medium as portal interior not fully verified.

PG.notes: AIP book sold by NiuSky Pacific for K100 (+K120 supplement); no free public eAIP portal. AIP supplements posted as PDFs on website but main instrument approach charts require purchase. No coded/AIXM data. Quarterly amendment cycle.

BO.notes: NAABOL (successor to AASANA, created 2021) publishes AIP Bolivia in PDF format. Subscription requires formal written request, payment proof, and delivery of login credentials. ERAU LibGuides classifies access as 'paid/fee'. AIS portal at ais.naabol.gob.bo was returning 503 at research time. Procedures are published as PDFs; one sample (TARIJA-PMR.pdf) is an image-heavy PDF with raster content. Full AIP effective May 2024 confirmed received by Garmin. Score 9: paid subscription required, PDF format (possibly scanned), access difficult/unreliable. +1 for access friction and unreliable portal.

CR.notes: COCESNA publishes Eurocontrol-style eAIP HTML for all Central American states (from AMDT 25/23). HTML pages contain aerodrome operational text; SID/STAR/IAP procedure charts are linked as separate PDF files (not embedded HTML tables). Open access, no login required. Updated on AIRAC 28-day cycle. Spanish language. PDF charts are vector (text-selectable). No AIXM output.

DK.aip_authority: Naviair / Danish Civil Aviation and Railway Authority (Trafikstyrelsen)
DK.notes: Open AIP portal at aim.naviair.dk (no registration). All AIP sections including SID/STAR/IAP charts are published as individual vector-text PDF files; no HTML eAIP package found — documents are direct PDF media links. Covers Denmark, Faroe Islands, and Greenland. ECAC state — AIXM 5.1 via EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free registration). Updated each AIRAC cycle.

EC.aip_authority: DGAC Ecuador (Dirección General de Aviación Civil)
EC.notes: DGAC IFIS3 portal publishes eAIP in open HTML format without login. Airport sections (AD 2 SEQM, AD 2 SEGU, etc.) list RNAV SID/STAR procedures with links; general text sections (GEN, ENR) are directly readable HTML. Confirmed open access on GEN 0.1 page. Actual procedure legs appear in linked chart pages (not inline tabular), adding navigation friction. Updated through 2026 AICs. No AIXM or coded DB. Score 4: open eAIP HTML with irregular structure (procedure legs in linked PDF charts, not inline tables).

KE.notes: KCAA eAIP portal requires paid subscription: USD 200/yr international, USD 100/yr East African. Content available in HTML and PDF formats. SID/STAR procedures in PDF charts and some HTML text. No AIXM data. Portal navigation adds friction. AIRAC cycle aligned.

ET.notes: ECAA publishes a PDF AIP updated twice per year (not full AIRAC cycle). No functioning public eAIP portal found; the ECAA website (ecaa.gov.et) returns 403/503 for AIM pages. AIP distributed by subscription or formal request. No AIXM data. Procedures exist as PDF charts. Confidence medium: no direct verification of current portal or access terms possible.

NA.notes: NCAA AIS publishes AIP and amendment pages. Portal at ncaa.com.na lists 3 AIP documents but currently shows 'no available documents'; login section present indicating account-gated download. Format is PDF (no eAIP HTML or AIXM evident). No AIRAC-aligned cadence confirmed; amendment-page distribution. No open coded data. Score 8: PDF behind account with uncertain availability.

NL.aip_authority: LVNL (Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland — Air Traffic Control the Netherlands)
NL.notes: LVNL publishes eAIP HTML at eaip.lvnl.nl updated per 28-day AIRAC cycle. SID/STAR/IAP for EHAM/Schiphol and other airports available as both HTML sections and PDF charts. Direct HTTP fetch blocked by server (403), but document classification sources confirm open/free access (no registration listed). Also in EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free account) as AIXM 4.5/5.1. No open coded procedure database. Confidence medium due to server blocking on verification.

CZ.aip_authority: ANS CR / AIM Centre (Air Navigation Services of the Czech Republic)
CZ.notes: Open HTML eAIP at aim.rlp.cz (no registration). Aerodrome sections reference SID/STAR/IAP as linked PDF chart files within the HTML framework; procedure text context in HTML but chart data in vector PDFs. ECAC state — AIXM 5.1 available via EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free registration). Updated each AIRAC cycle.

IS.notes: Isavia publishes full eAIP HTML at eaip.isavia.is with AIRAC cycle indexing. HTML pages (BI-AD-2.BIKF-*-en-GB.html) contain parseable operational text (runway data, comms, navaid tables). SID/STAR/IAP charts are linked as PDF files (e.g. BIKF_7_RWY_19_RNAV_SID.pdf). Open access, no registration required. AIRAC 28-day cycle. English and Icelandic. No AIXM output identified.

CH.aip_authority: skyguide (Swiss Air Navigation Services Ltd, AIM unit) / BAZL (Federal Office of Civil Aviation)
CH.notes: Switzerland's eAIP is distributed exclusively via the skybriefing.com portal operated by skyguide, at a paid annual subscription of CHF 92.50/year for the eAIP (plus CHF 53.30 for eVFR). SID/STAR/IAP procedures are in HTML and PDF behind the paywall. Physical AIP also sold via aimshop-skyguide.ch. Also in EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free account) as AIXM 4.5/5.1 for significant point data. No open coded procedure database. +1 friction penalty applied for paid portal requirement.

TZ.notes: TCAA AIP covers Dar es Salaam FIR; updated by amendment pages issued ~4 times per year (not strict AIRAC). AIP SUP 03/2019 documented subscription fees for initial purchase and annual renewal, paid via government e-payment gateway or bank transfer. Format is PDF (reprinted amendment pages). TCAA website (tcaa.go.tz) is accessible but AIP pages return 403. No eAIP HTML or AIXM. TCAA is procuring an AIXM 5.x + eAIP system but not yet deployed. Score 8: PDF with paid subscription, portal navigation friction.

BE.notes: skeyes publishes open eAIP HTML and PDF at ops.skeyes.be, updated 13 times/year per AIRAC cycle. Belgium and Luxembourg covered together. SID/STAR/IAP procedures in standard EUROCONTROL eAIP HTML tables plus PDF charts. No login required for browsing. Also in EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free account) as AIXM 4.5/5.1. No open coded ARINC 424 database.

AT.notes: Open eAIP portal at eaip.austrocontrol.at (no registration). SID/STAR/IAP procedures are individual vector-text PDF chart files licensed CC BY 4.0. Full AIP ZIP download available. No HTML procedure tables — charts only in PDF. ECAC state — AIXM 5.1 via EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free registration). Updated each AIRAC cycle.

GL.aip_authority: Naviair / Danish Civil Aviation and Railway Authority (Trafikstyrelsen)
GL.notes: Greenland AIP published by Naviair at aim.naviair.dk. Procedures delivered as individual vector PDF files per airport (BG_AD_2_BGBW_en.pdf, BG_AD_2_BGBW_RNP_Y_RWY_06_1_en.pdf, etc.) directly downloadable without login. No eAIP HTML index confirmed for Greenland section; approach and aerodrome charts are standalone PDFs. PDFs are text-selectable (FrameMaker-generated vector). AIRAC-aligned. Limited airports (major: BGGH Nuuk, BGSF Kangerlussuaq, BGQO Qaqortoq as of Apr 2026).

HU.notes: HungaroControl publishes open EUROCONTROL-spec eAIP HTML at ais.hungarocontrol.hu, no login required. SID/STAR procedure legs are in HTML + linked PDF charts. No AIXM download; obstacle data only in Excel. Also available via EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free registration). AIRAC cycle aligned.

ZM.notes: ZACL AIM portal (aim.zacl.co.zm) manages Zambia AIP. Access requires completing an order form and paying fees by bank transfer to ZACL (Standard Chartered, SWIFT SCBLZMLX). AIP can be downloaded electronically or ordered as hard copy; format is PDF. New AIP issued Feb 2022. No eAIP HTML or AIXM. Upgrading to ICAO AIM systems but no digital open access yet. Score 9: paid subscription, PDF only, formal order process required.

ZW.notes: CAAZ AIP portal (caaz.co.zw/aip) found suspended ('This Account has been suspended') as of June 2026. AIP historically requires active paid subscription; digital data sets or paper distribution per CAAZ documentation. No eAIP HTML or AIXM available publicly. Contact: ais@caaz.co.zw. Score 9: paid/restricted access, portal currently down, poor digital availability.

HN.aip_authority: AHAC (Agencia Hondureña de Aeronáutica Civil) / COCESNA
HN.notes: Honduras eAIP published via COCESNA (same platform as Costa Rica). Eurocontrol-style eAIP HTML with operational text in HTML; SID/STAR/IAP procedure charts linked as vector PDFs (e.g. MH_AD-2.MHTG SID RNP RWY02). Open access, no login. AIRAC 28-day cycle. Spanish. No AIXM output. Identical structure and friction level to CR.

BW.notes: CAAB AIP described as 'published in loose-leaf paper form' (English only). Digital distribution via password-protected portal (caab.co.bw/aip-login) requiring account registration. AIP, AIP SUP and AIRAC content behind login. No eAIP HTML or AIXM publicly available. Subscription/contact required for paper copy: aishq@caab.co.bw. Score 8: account-gated PDF/paper, no open coded data, format and availability uncertain post-registration.

CG.aip_authority: ASECNA (Agency for Aerial Navigation Safety in Africa and Madagascar)
CG.notes: Republic of Congo (FC) AIP published via ASECNA regional eAIP at aim.asecna.aero, open access without login. eAIP is bilingual French/English HTML for ENR sections; aerodrome SID/STAR procedure legs are in PDF chart files under /cartes/atlas/congo/. No omnidirectional SID at FCBB Brazzaville per eAIP text. No AIXM data. French-first interface and per-chart PDF navigation add friction (+1). AIRAC cycle aligned. Score 7 (open PDF charts behind portal navigation).

GY.notes: GCAA publishes an Integrated AIP (IAIP) as a static PDF. Only publicly accessible version found is dated January 2020 (Guyana-IAIP-latest-jan-2020.pdf); no eAIP HTML, no evidence of AIRAC-cycle updates since then. PDF appears to be FrameMaker-generated vector (text-selectable) not scanned. No current AIRAC-aligned AIP confirmed; contact required for current data. No AIXM output.
